motivation.parent_rule: Zero marginal MI / apparent randomization is not sufficient; the retained fully-crossed successor binder must also survive an explicit nuisance-only challenger and semantic-evidence ablation challenger.

exact_source_identity.byte_binding_method: For generator, challenger and test, exact local bytes were converted to Git blob SHA-1 and matched against GitHub fetch_file blob identities before the recorded deterministic run.

challenger_method.model_visible_input_under_test: row.prompt only, matching the generator's model_visible_fields contract
challenger_method.semantic_ablation: Replace exactly the EVIDENCE span between EVIDENCE and PROPOSITION with <EVIDENCE_ABLATED>; keep codebook, proposition, query/polarity and all other model-visible nuisance surface unchanged.
challenger_method.nuisance_only_decoder: Bayes-optimal exact-signature majority lookup over the ablated model-visible prompt. If the realized nuisance surface carries class/target information, this upper bound rises above 1/3.
acceptance: every ablated signature contains all three classes with equal counts
every ablated signature contains all three target slots with equal counts
full unablated prompt signatures remain label-specific at source-blueprint scope
audit metadata remains outside model-visible projection
challenger_method.important_boundary: Exact-signature chance is a strong deterministic realized-dataset check for this nuisance surface, but it is not a proof against every generalized nuisance function and does not prove that a trained model will use the intended semantic mechanism.

adversarial_regressions: missing one semantic-class support family -> challenger FAIL
audit metadata added to model-visible fields -> challenger FAIL

swarm_adjudication.AdversarialShortcutHunter: PASS_AT_BLUEPRINT_SCOPE: nuisance-only exact-signature decoder is forced to chance on realized 2592-row v2 blueprint and injected nuisance tags are detected.
swarm_adjudication.StatisticalReviewer: PASS_AT_BLUEPRINT_SCOPE: both semantic-class and target-slot nuisance lookup equal 1/3 exactly; every ablated signature has balanced support 3/3.
swarm_adjudication.DatasetArchitect: RETAIN_V2_BLUEPRINT; rerun this challenger after exact ABI atom rendering and final serialization.
swarm_adjudication.MechanisticReviewer: NO_INTERNAL_MECHANISM_CREDIT: dataset ablation does not establish post-FT J-Space causality or semantic mechanism installation.
swarm_adjudication.ABIProvenanceReviewer: PRODUCTION_BLOCKED: blueprint still contains ABI slots and no final checkpoint-local 46-atom tokenizer-bound split materialization was exercised.
